funnel.title: Activation funnel
funnel.intro: Organisations created in the period, followed through every later step. Select a step to list the organisations stuck at it.

org.notePlaceholder: A note for the team (never shown to the organisation)
org.suspendedBanner: This organisation is suspended: it is read-only and starts no jobs.
org.reasonHint: Required. Kept in the audit log; plan, trial, override and suspension also appear in the organisation's own log.
org.overrideValueHint: A number or true / false. Leave empty to remove the override.
org.suspendBody: Members keep read access; every change and every new job is refused until it is reactivated.
org.reactivateBody: Members can work again at once.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.endSessionBody: {device} is signed out at once. The person can sign in again anywhere.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Every organisation is on one plan. New organisations start on the default plan; customers see the public plans on their billing page. A change to a plan applies to every organisation on it at once.
plans.name: Name
plans.orgsOn: {n, plural, =0 {No organisation is on this plan.} one {# organisation is on this plan.} other {# organisations are on this plan.}}
plans.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It can't be changed later.
plans.descriptionHint: One line on the plan card.
plans.priceHint: Empty: no price is shown. Shown only; nothing is charged yet.
plans.priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more, with at most two decimals.
plans.positionHint: Plans are listed from the lowest number up.
plans.publicField: Customers see this plan on their billing page
plans.defaultField: New organisations start on this plan (the default)
plans.limitsIntro: A limit is a whole number, or no limit. Organisation overrides still apply on top of the plan.
plans.impactNone: {n, plural, =0 {No organisation is on this plan.} one {The organisation on this plan stays within these limits.} other {All # organisations on this plan stay within these limits.}}
plans.impactOver: {limit}: {n, plural, one {# organisation would be} other {# organisations would be}} over the new limit.
plans.impactFeature: {limit}: {n, plural, one {# organisation would lose it} other {# organisations would lose it}}.
plans.impactRule: Nothing is deleted: an organisation over a limit keeps what it has, and new use past the limit is refused.
plans.saveBody: {n, plural, =0 {No organisation is on this plan yet.} one {The change applies at once to the # organisation on this plan.} other {The change applies at once to the # organisations on this plan.}}
plans.deleteBody: No organisation is on this plan. It is removed for good.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.currencyHint: The three-letter ISO 4217 code of every plan price, for example EUR or USD.
settings.publicSignUpOn: Sign-up is open: anyone with an email address can create an account at /sign-up, and their first organisation starts on the default plan.
settings.publicSignUpOff: Sign-up is closed: accounts come only from setup links and invitations.
settings.openingBody: From now on anyone can create an account. Check the default plan's limits first.
settings.closingBody: New people can no longer create accounts. Existing accounts and invitations are not affected.
